usageNotes: Use this to permanently remove a remote Proxmox instance from PDM management; the remote entry is deleted synchronously (returns null, not a UPID). Pass `delete-token: true` to also revoke the API token that PDM created on the remote — omitting this leaves a dangling token on the remote side. Requires `Resource.Modify` privilege on the resource.

examples.summary: Remove a managed remote and revoke its PDM API token

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the remote from PDM management, severing all visibility and control over that Proxmox node; if `delete-token` is false, the orphaned API token remains active on the remote.
tips: Always pass delete-token=true unless you have a specific reason to retain the API token on the remote (e.g., the token is shared with another PDM instance).
The remote ID must match the pattern /^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._\-]*)$/ and be 2–32 characters — use list_remotes to confirm the exact ID before deleting.
This operation is synchronous and returns null on success; no task UPID is issued, so there is nothing to poll.
